data: At what x-axis value do all the lines intersect in the left graph?

The question asks for the x-axis value at which all the lines intersect in the left graph. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents 'rank(o)/T'. The left graph is labeled as (a), which corresponds to WCFG. 

Looking at the left graph, we can see multiple lines representing different symbols. These lines appear to intersect at approximately 0.5 on the x-axis. This can be verified by observing where the lines converge before they start to diverge again. Therefore, the x-axis value at which all the lines intersect is around 0.5.
